_about: Facts reported by outlets this week (Oct 5-9) about THIS season only. Multi-season trends (last 10, last 21, since a coach was hired) are left out: the Desk uses current-season data only.
phi-jax: The Jaguars defense has allowed 53 points all season.
The line moved two points toward Jacksonville after the Eagles' offensive-line news (Johnson retired, Jurgens traded).
lv-ne: The Raiders have covered all four games this season.
min-no: New Orleans has scored 24+ in all four games and throws on about two-thirds of its snaps.
chi-gb: The Bears have won two straight with backup quarterbacks; their defense has held three straight opponents to 12 or fewer.
The Packers are winless against the spread this season.
ind-pit: Pittsburgh played Thursday in Week 4; Indianapolis is back from London with no bye.
hou-ten: Both teams are winless; Houston is 0-4 against the spread.
sf-sea: Seattle has allowed the fewest passing yards in the league.
San Francisco has allowed zero sacks on 113 pass attempts.
bal-atl: Atlanta has the league's No. 1 run defense (48.3 rushing yards allowed per game).
Atlanta has scored 80 points in two straight wins since Michael Penix returned.
Derrick Henry has 23+ carries in three of four games.
buf-la: Buffalo leads the league in scoring but allows 26+ points per game; it lost for the first time last week, as a 6.5-point favorite.
det-ari: Detroit has allowed 17 touchdowns, most in the NFL; Arizona is 29th in points allowed (29.3).
Detroit is playing man 15.7% of the time this season, with Cover 3 on 47.7% of snaps.
nyg-was: Jayden Daniels returns from the dislocated elbow.
den-lac: Denver scores a league-low 3.3 first-half points per game; the Chargers are 0-4.
Bo Nix ranks 35th of 38 qualifying QBs by PFF grade.
cle-nyj: Cleveland has won three straight, driven by its defense; the Jets scored 12 in Week 4.
Cleveland plays man on an NFL-high 50% of dropbacks (Next Gen Stats).
cin-mia: Miami is averaging about 11.5 points per game.
The total fell from 48.5 to about 42.5 on the Bengals' receiver injuries.
